claim.what: Concentration risk: by_regime + by_signal_type×regime×sector = Choppy regime (96.3%) with UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell at 22.22%; recommended action: Pause new UP_TRI entries in Choppy regime, especially in Bank sector, until Choppy exposure drops below 80% via natural Day-6 exits or a regime shift; do not add to the UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell (currently 12 positions). Consider a Bank-sector index short or DOWN_TRI hedge to offset the 12-name Bank concentration.
claim.expected_effect: Trader awareness of tail risk: If regime flips from Choppy to Bear or a sharp Bank-sector shock hits, 94.4% directional-long exposure — concentrated in 12 Bank names — takes correlated drawdown simultaneously with no validated cohort edge (only Candidate-tier n=339) to justify holding through. Loss compounds across the book rather than being isolated to a diversified subset.

evidence: Both concentrated cells match only Candidate-tier Choppy×UP_TRI cohort (n=339) — unvalidated edge

decision_metadata.llm_rationale: Regime concentration is triggered at 96.3% Choppy (52/54, well above 0.80) AND the UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell breaches the 0.20 cell threshold at 22.22% (12/54). UP_TRI is 45/54 = 83.3% and combined with BULL_PROXY the book is 51/54 = 94.4% directional-long — effectively a monoculture. Both concentrated cells match only the Candidate-tier Choppy×UP_TRI cohort (n=339) — unvalidated edge, extending a multi-week warn streak.
